Future<void> inOrder<E>(Iterable<E> items, Future<void> Function(E item) step, {required String reason}) async { for (final item in items) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await client.put(item);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await audit.save(item);
} }

Future<void> use() async {
  await inOrder([], (value) async {}, reason: "Each update reads the previous write");
}
